name: SF Infinite Item Split
description: Preserves the source stack after the split amount selected in the game is transferred.

changelog: Removes redundant split controls and restores the source stack for the One, Half, or CustomAmount selected in game.

sections.title: Infinite Item Split
sections.description: The game chooses the split amount. This mod restores the source stack after the game consumes a One, Half, or CustomAmount split; there are no extra split settings.
